def render_header(targets: List[Path], is_system_scan: bool) ->Text:
    from rich.text import Text
    version = get_safety_version()
    now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
    timestamp = now.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC")
    
    if is_system_scan:
        header_text = f"Safety {version} running system scan"
    else:
        if targets:
            target_names = ", ".join(str(t) for t in targets)
            header_text = f"Safety {version} scanning {target_names}"
        else:
            header_text = f"Safety {version} scanning"
    
    text = Text(header_text)
    text.append(f"\n{timestamp}")
    return text

def print_header(console, targets: List[Path], is_system_scan: bool=False
    ) ->None:
    header_text = render_header(targets, is_system_scan)
    console.print(header_text)
